question: How does the power of action function as both binding and liberating?
premises: The power of action binds when it abides in its own path.
When known, the same power brings about accomplishment.
This power is proclaimed as the expansion from A to Ha.
inference: The same phonemic expansion of the power of action binds in ignorance and grants accomplishment when known.
plain_english: Abiding in its own path it binds, but when known it brings accomplishment; it is proclaimed as the expansion from A to Ha.
